body: As I approached the second key, my heart raced. It was an antique key—a perfect fit for its lock. But something felt... off. The handle seemed slightly misshapen, like it had been used too many times. My hand trembled as I picked up the key, wondering if someone might have broken into my studio.
full:
As I approached the second key, my heart raced. It was an antique key—a perfect fit for its lock. But something felt... off. The handle seemed slightly misshapen, like it had been used too many times. My hand trembled as I picked up the key, wondering if someone might have broken into my studio.

Next: move closer and examine it carefully
